item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a service waits for its in-flight dispatches before it re-executes; reckon/crew/station.py:399, reckon/crew/follower_reload.py:511 and reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1003 each call the one bounded wait immediately before os.execve, and queue_admission._launch_queued launches in process through reckon.crew.dispatch, so the register is populated in the same process that waits.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records gate 5/5, the base and after arms with revisions and failure ids, the four mutation logs, the third failing id attributed to a base-arm measurement, and one rubric line per dimension.

justifications.durability: the three service cases redden when their own wait is removed (negative-control-station.log, -follower.log, -admit.log), but nothing exercises the register's entry at dispatch_claims.py:944, so deleting that line leaves all five cases green.
justifications.evidence: the gate at tests/test_a_reexec_waits_for_its_dispatches.py passes 5/5 at head and its arms are logged with EXIT lines, but the done-when's ruff clause has no recorded receipt and the two arms do not cover the same file set.
justifications.fit: the register, its Condition and REEXEC_DISPATCH_WAIT_SECONDS at dispatch_claims.py:805 sit beside the claim lifecycle in the same section-comment idiom, and no name carries a plan, stage or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:803 keeps one process-wide register entered at the node claim (line 944) and left at every claim-released and worker-started path, and the three named services reach it at station.py:399, follower_reload.py:511 and queue_admission.py:1003.
justifications.reuse: a search of reckon/crew for an in-flight dispatch register or a pre-exec wait found none, and the wait is one definition at dispatch_claims.py:835 extended by three call sites rather than one per service.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is one of the five declared write paths, the done-when's named test, or the landing fragment auto-granted by dispatch_claims.py:1134, and no plan state was mutated.
